mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, c.card_type AS cardType, c.card_image_url AS cardImageUrl, cv.card_network AS cardNetwork, c.annual_fee AS annualFee, uc.pan_last4 AS panLast4, uc.status AS status, uc.is_primary AS primaryCard, uc.recommendation_enabled AS recommendationEnabled FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON uc.card_id = c.card_id INNER JOIN card_variants cv ON c.card_variant_id = cv.card_variant_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY uc.is_primary DESC, uc.created_at DESC

SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, c.card_type AS cardType, c.card_image_url AS cardImageUrl, c.description AS description, cv.card_network AS cardNetwork, c.annual_fee AS annualFee, uc.pan_last4 AS panLast4, uc.token_expiry_date AS tokenExpiryDate, uc.status AS status, uc.is_primary AS primaryCard, uc.recommendation_enabled AS recommendationEnabled, c.is_supported AS supported, c.min_benefit_amount AS minBenefitAmount, uc.created_at AS createdAt FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON uc.card_id = c.card_id INNER JOIN card_variants cv ON c.card_variant_id = cv.card_variant_id WHERE uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, c.min_benefit_amount AS minBenefitAmount, c.benefits_info AS benefitsInfo FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON uc.card_id = c.card_id WHERE uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, #{yearMonth} AS targetYearMonth, COALESCE(cms.total_spending_amount, 0) AS currentSpendingAmount, COALESCE(c.min_benefit_amount, 0) AS requiredSpendingAmount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON uc.card_id = c.card_id LEFT JOIN card_monthly_status cms ON uc.user_card_id = cms.user_card_id AND cms.target_year_month = #{yearMonth} WHERE uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE user_cards SET is_primary = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_primary = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_cards SET is_primary = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_cards SET recommendation_enabled = #{recommendationEnabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
